'''Yudai Chiba''' (Japanese: '''千葉雄大''' ''Chiba Yūdai'') is a Japanese voice actor {{aniseries|PTS}}. 

==Biography==
Chiba was born on March 9, 1989 in {{wp|Miyagi Prefecture}}. {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. He joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, where his only role was [[Ilima]], a recurring character. Chiba is currently affiliated with Japan Music Entertainment.
